subject.title: [Bug]: openclaw agent --deliver silently drops messages (exit 0, no delivery)

question: Should maintainers resolve the open fork PR and apply the existing `message send` boundary decision to this issue, leaving delivery-failure status to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46830 and live/session injection to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83809?
rationale: Source and docs show current behavior is agent-reply delivery, and a related PR already has maintainer rejection of the direct literal-send boundary; however the open closing-reference fork PR prevents automated cleanup without a human product/security decision.

options.title: Resolve fork PR and narrow the issue
options.body: Decline or close the open fork PR, then keep only narrower follow-ups for delivery status and security-reviewed session injection.

options.title: Sponsor explicit direct mode
options.body: Define a new explicit direct-delivery flag or API that does not change the shared `deliver` contract and includes upgrade/security proof.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue as the umbrella for direct notifications plus session injection, accepting overlap with the narrower open issues.

recommendation.title: Resolve fork PR and narrow the issue
recommendation.body: Decline or close the open fork PR, then keep only narrower follow-ups for delivery status and security-reviewed session injection.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest product-boundary signal is steipete's maintainer comment closing the related direct-delivery PR.
